# Harbour Lights — Canon index

## Characters

- C01 Kamala (කමලා) — mother, 52. Faded blue cotton saree, white cardigan in the mornings. Voice: low, clipped, a Sri Lankan (southern) accent.
- C02 Nimal (නිමල්) — elder son, 30. Grey linen shirt, rolled sleeves, cheap digital watch. Voice: soft, measured.
- C03 Sunil (සුනිල්) — younger son, 19. Faded red T-shirt, sarong when on the boat. Voice: quiet, hesitant.
- C04 Mrs. Perera — neighbour, 60s. Floral housecoat, reading glasses on a cord.

## Locations

- L01 Kamala's house — kitchen with a wood fire, front yard with a jak tree.
- L02 Kalugala harbour breakwater — concrete breakwater, the blue-and-white lighthouse.
- L03 Auction shed — wet concrete floor, debt ledger pinned to the wall, tea kiosk at the gate.

## Props

- P01 The SEETHA — the family's blue fishing boat with the name painted in white.
- P02 Sunil's tide notebook — small, water-stained, pencil tied with string.
- P03 The fishing licence — laminated card kept in a tin trunk.
- P04 Guesthouse plan — a printed floor plan on A3 paper.
